summary.result: Monitoring results confirmed that water quality improvement by abating nonpoint source pollution in rural watershed of monsoon climate should be focused on source control.
summary.background: A monitoring study has been conducted to identify hydrologic conditions, water quality and nutrient loading characteristics of small watershed in Juam Lake.
summary.method: T-P concentration of non-storm period also revealed that point source pollution is not serious in the watershed.
